`display interface ` (Huawei)
`show ip interface brief` + `show interface detail` (Juniper) | | **REST API** | Base URL of the device’s API, authentication token/credentials | `GET https:///api/v1/interfaces/` | If you’re working with the REST API, I can help you build the exact request. Just let me know: 1. The device’s IP or hostname (or the full base URL). 2. The interface name you’re interested in (e.g., `GigabitEthernet0/1`). 3. Whether you’re using basic auth, bearer token, or another method. Once I have that, I can craft a sample `requests_get` call for you.
